name: migrations
instructions: Read docs/ops/DEPLOY_MIGRATION_ORDER_OF_OPERATIONS.md. Old tasks keep running during the deploy drain, so: new columns are nullable or defaulted; no rename or drop of anything the released code still reads (check the latest release tag, not main); no backfill in the same deploy; every new migration.sql is wrapped in BEGIN; ... COMMIT; unless it carries a '-- no-transaction: <reason>' line. Enum value removal must remap rows first.

name: security-boundary
instructions: Changes to the registry, grants, scope bindings, the stripper or a field's @sensitivity tier must ship in their own PR with no app or feature code (AGENTS.md boundary isolation rule). Flag any app code in the same PR. A new route needs its registry entry already on main. Comment-only changes must stay comment-only.

name: people-and-merge
instructions: A merge deletes the merged-away Person row and keeps a PersonMerge archive; an older merged row that is still referenced stays hidden. Merged people drop out of every live list. Queries that list people must filter merged records. Merge-chain walks must handle cycles and gaps.

name: money
instructions: The app never changes or deletes entries in QuickBooks; drift goes back to finance as a flag. Check amounts in integer cents, idempotency of anything a cron or webhook can repeat, and that a refund or reversal path matches docs/rules/revenue.md exactly. Who may approve or authorize is set by docs/rules; compare the code to the rule.

name: kiosk-and-scan
instructions: The Raspberry Pi kiosk parses these responses. Field names, status codes and the replay/fence behaviour must not change unless client/ changes in the same PR. Lock order is person then facility.

name: mail-intake
instructions: Mail from untrusted senders must never be auto-assigned. Authentication-Results parsing must fail closed on anything ambiguous. Check that a flood of untrusted mail cannot push a member's receipt out of the read window (per-run budgets, ledgering).

name: rules-docs
instructions: Every claim about current behaviour must match the code on main; read it. A tag change such as [Unsettled] to [Decision] needs an owner ruling recorded in the PR. Retiring a doc must not drop an open question or follow-up without a new home.
